mie - linux_aarch64 (RKNN) build

built     : 2026-09-30
platform  : ARM64 Linux (aarch64-rockchip1240-linux-gnu, GCC 12.4.0)
backend   : rknn
optim     : release
tflite    : not built (MIE_ENABLE_TFLITE_BACKENDS=OFF)

layout:
  include/  public headers, add -Iinclude
  lib/      libmie.a (static library) + librknnrt.so (RKNN runtime)
  bin/      mie_run, mie_bench (aarch64 ELF, link librknnrt.so)
  examples/ demo sources: run_model.cc (driver), bench_model.cc (benchmark,
            parsed with the vendored cmdline.h), common.h (shared helpers)
  testdata/ demo models (ssd/detect.tflite + labelmap.txt)
  README.md full documentation

Runtime note: the demos are linked with rpath $ORIGIN/../lib, so they find
librknnrt.so next to libmie.a. Keep the lib/ and bin/ directories together:

  cd bin && ./mie_run <model.rknn> rknn
  cd bin && ./mie_bench <model.rknn> -b rknn -n 100

This build contains ONLY the rknn backend (the TFLite cpu/gpu/qnn/mtk backends
are excluded). The RKNN backend loads Rockchip RKNN models (.rknn) produced by
rknn-toolkit2; the TFLite model under testdata/ is provided for reference only
and cannot be run by this backend.

Integration note: link libmie.a into your application and add -Iinclude. It
references the RKNN C API (rknn_init/rknn_run/...), so also link librknnrt.so
at the final link step.
